summary: Ventas Realty, Limited Partnership, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Ventas, Inc., filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of senior unsecured notes. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by Ventas, Inc. The filing is a routine debt shelf takedown; it does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or going-private transaction. Terms such as principal amount, coupon, maturity, and pricing are left blank at this preliminary stage.
